text: 国常会部署重点工作，首提完善资本市场稳市机制 刚刚过去的一周，多部门联合推出一系列稳市举措，提振市场信心。
text_en: State Council executive meeting deploys key tasks, raises improving capital market stabilization mechanism for the first time. In the past week, multiple departments jointly rolled out a series of market-stabilizing measures to boost market confidence.
